validity.recommendation: Demote spec confidence to low and add ResearcherNotes flag: the distinct 43 km / 30-in 'Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah 2' entity is not independently verifiable; its sole cited source does not support it. Do not treat as high-confidence.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE of the broad corridor is real, but the SPECIFIC GEM entity is unsupported. Independent evidence (saudipedia, Aramco Arabic press) confirms Hawiyah Gas Plant processes sour gas from the al-Khuff and al-Jawf deep reservoirs in the Ghawar field and feeds the Master Gas System, and that the Haradh/Hawiyah program built a large new gas pipeline NETWORK (Aramco Arabic: ~2,700 km of new gathering/transmission lines; ~3,700 km total) -- so 'Khuff gas to Hawiyah' lines physically exist. BUT: (1) The 43 km / 30-in / operating spec for 'Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah 2' appears ONLY on GEM/gem.wiki pages and GEM-derived search summaries; no independent source names a discrete 43 km, 30-in line. (2) The page's single citation is OPEC Annual Statistics Bulletin 2012 p.75 (and ASB2013 p.79 on sibling pages). I pulled both: the ASB is an aggregate-volumes statistics bulletin -- url_verifier on ASB2012.pdf returns 200 but the document contains NEITHER 'Haradh', 'Hawiyah', nor even 'pipeline'. So the cited source does NOT support the pipeline's name, length, diameter, or status -- the spec is effectively uncited. (3) The independent GlobalData/offshore-technology profile of a 'Haradh-Hawiyah Gas' line gives 450 km / max 36 in (a different, larger project), directly contradicting 43 km / 30 in. Net: real corridor, but P1918 as a discrete verifiable 43 km line is unconfirmed and rests on a citation that doesn't actually back it.

validity.recommendation: Review P1917 / P1918 / P1919 as a likely segment triple-count; confirm with Aramco/route data whether three discrete parallel 43 km / 30-in lines truly exist or this is one corridor split into three identical rows.
validity.researcher_notes: P1917 (Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah), P1918 (-2), P1919 (-3) are three rows with IDENTICAL specs: len=43 km, dia=30 in, status=operating, end=Al Hawiyah, owner=Saudi Aramco 100%, and ALL THREE cite the same single source (OPEC ASB2012 p.75). No independent source confirms three separate parallel lines at these specs; independent material describes a gathering/transmission NETWORK, not three named twin lines. This pattern (identical clones differing only by a trailing number, same lone citation) is a classic relabel/double-count risk. P1918 is very plausibly the same physical corridor as P1917 (and P1919) rather than a distinct third pipe. Naming the most likely merge target: P1917 (Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah gas pipeline).

validity.recommendation: Fix EndState/Province: Al Hawiyah (Hawiyah Gas Plant) is in the Eastern Province (Ghawar field), not Makkah. Verify start endpoint (Haradh, also Eastern Province).
validity.researcher_notes: GEM records EndState/Province = 'Makkah' for the Al Hawiyah endpoint. This is wrong: the Hawiyah Gas Plant sits at the south end of the Ghawar field in Saudi Arabia's EASTERN Province (confirmed by saudipedia and Aramco material describing al-Khuff/al-Jawf Ghawar reservoirs feeding the plant). Haradh is likewise in the Eastern Province. 'Makkah' is almost certainly a confusion with the unrelated Madrakah-Al Hawiyah line (P3961) or a data-entry slip. Province should be Eastern Province for both endpoints.

validity.recommendation: Treat 43 km and 30 in as low-confidence/uncited; do not present as corroborated. Replace the OPEC-ASB citation, which does not contain the pipeline or its specs.
validity.researcher_notes: Length 43 km and diameter 30 in cannot be corroborated by any independent source and are NOT supported by the page's only citation (OPEC ASB2012 p.75 / ASB2013 p.79 -- aggregate statistics, no pipeline names/specs; verifier confirms the PDF lacks 'Haradh'/'Hawiyah'/'pipeline'). The one independent profile (GlobalData/offshore-technology) gives 450 km / 36 in for a 'Haradh-Hawiyah Gas' line -- materially DIFFERENT, so it does not agree with GEM. Capacity is blank and I found no reliable per-line figure (program-level only). Fuel=Gas is correct (Khuff is non-associated/sour gas). Owner Saudi Aramco 100% is well corroborated. Net: owner/fuel OK; length and diameter are unconfirmed and conflict with the only independent figure available -- never silently pass.

fills.researcher_notes: Owner Saudi Aramco 100% is corroborated: the Haradh-Hawiyah Gas pipeline corridor is attributed to Saudi Arabian Oil (Saudi Aramco) by GlobalData/offshore-technology, and the Hawiyah Gas Plant / Khuff-gas processing is an Aramco asset per saudipedia. Two independent origins agree on Aramco ownership of this corridor.

Fuel=Gas confirmed: saudipedia states the Hawiyah plant processes sour GAS from the al-Khuff and al-Jawf deep reservoirs (non-associated/sour gas), consistent with a dry-gas transmission line to the Master Gas System. Classification as a gas line (not NGL/oil) is correct.

summary: P1918 Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah 2: corridor and Aramco/gas classification are real, but the discrete 43 km/30-in entity is unconfirmed (sole OPEC-ASB citation contains no pipeline/specs), is a likely triple-count with P1917/P1919, lists wrong province (Makkah vs Eastern), and its specs conflict with the only independent profile (450 km/36 in).
